title: 第5章 烈焰草
content_zh:
翌日清晨，蓝天万里无云，碎阳泼洒金光。

街道上白雪皑皑，往来行人匆匆。陆凡大步往药材铺的方向走，口袋里带满了金币，这几乎是他的所有积蓄。

昨夜拿到武技崩山拳之后，陆凡便仔细研读，先读懂，读透，然后再开始修炼。

他发现，修炼崩山拳最关键的，倒不是手臂问题，而是药材问题。

这套武技，是配合药材一起修炼的，需要一种比较好的疗伤药材，烈焰草。而如果没有这一味药材，那么单纯将手臂往石头砸，无疑是白痴行径。

故此，一大早，陆凡便出门买这一味药材。

对于烈焰草，陆凡还是知道一些的。毕竟他也是武学世家出身，各种药材有何用，也是必须要知道的，毕竟他们陆家也开的有药材铺，就是卖的很贵，自家弟子去买，还不打折。

走到主城大街，这一条街倒是熙熙攘攘，人声鼎沸。

寒冷的天气，并不能减少大家对逛街的热情。沿街的小贩，鳞次栉比的店铺，依旧宾客满门。

陆凡一边走，一边寻找着烈焰草的身影。倘若能在外面的小贩摊上找到，无疑使最好的。因为小贩开的价，通常都要比店铺便宜很多，而且看情况还能讲价，非常适合陆凡这种腰包并不宽裕的人。

看了半条街，陆凡也没有看到烈焰草的身影。

烈焰草是一种火红色的药材，根部为白色最佳，蓝色其次，通体全红最次。

陆凡一个一个摊位的寻找着，终于，他在靠近武器铺的一个小贩摊前看到了一堆火红色的烈焰草。

陆凡心中一喜，缓步上前，像是闲逛一样，在小贩的面前动翻翻，西看看，然后才拿起其中一株烈焰草道：“这个多少钱。”

陆凡略微皱起眉头，五个银币已经相当于普通三口之家一个月的开销了。他浑身上下加起来也就十多个金币而已，显然没办法将面前这一堆烈焰草全部买完。

陆凡放下烈焰草，道：“太贵了，我还是去别处看看吧。”

转身欲走，小贩叫住了他道：“那就四个银币一株，你要买的多，我再给你打个折。公子，这种烈焰草可不好采摘，你去别的地方买，肯定没有这个价了。”

陆凡转过头，又在这一堆烈焰草上随便翻翻，心中暗暗数着这一堆烈焰草到底有多少株，够不够他支撑一个月的时间。

正数着，就在这时，陆凡忽的伸手在烈焰草的根部一摸，顿时发现有几根烈焰草的根部居然是白色的。

心脏猛然跳动，白根的烈焰草可要比通体全红的烈焰草珍贵十倍不止。按照崩山拳武技书上说的，如果用白色的烈焰草来修炼，速度会增加一倍。

陆凡强行忍住自己的狂喜，不让面色有任何变化。

调整了一下情绪，陆凡对着小贩伸出三根手指道：“三个银币一株，你的这些，我都要了。”

小贩咬咬牙，思索了一会儿道：“成交。”

陆凡立马掏钱给他，然后伸手将一堆烈焰草抱起。

正暗爽着，忽的身躯被人撞了一下。转头看去，映入眼帘的是一名身着武者服的年轻人。

此人看起来与陆凡差不多大的年纪，国字脸，身材魁梧，青色的武者服上有着武道学院特有的标示。显然此人对于自己是武道学院的学员感到自豪。

陆凡也认了出来，他是江临城第一武道世家莫家的少公子，莫云飞。

“呦，这不是陆家的废物陆凡吗？怎么，一大早起来帮家里进药材了啊。你不是应该去西山采药吗？”

莫云飞笑的开心，跟在他身后的莫家家丁也同时笑了起来。

伸手，莫云飞从陆凡怀中拿过两株烈焰草。陆凡一把夺了回来道：“莫少爷，你逛你的街，我们互不打扰，告辞。”

莫云飞身后的几个家丁挡住了陆凡的路。莫云飞上下打量了陆凡几眼道：“几天不见，变硬气了啊？就算是陆明在我面前，也不敢嚣张，你算什么东西。”

陆凡道：“莫少爷，你这句话，应该对陆明说去。”

莫云飞笑了，拍拍手道：“说的好。我会找个机会好好教训他的。看看你们陆家，像你这样的废物都还养着，就这还想跟我们莫家比，差的真不是一点半点。”

说着，莫云飞伸手一掌把陆凡手上的药材打散在地。

陆凡眼中带着怒火，已经捏紧了拳头。他的大脑告诉他要冷静，莫云飞至少也是炼体**重的武者，他绝不可能是对手。

强行控制住自己的情绪，陆凡弯下了腰，一点一点将地上的烈焰草捡了起来。

莫云飞站在旁边看着，笑声不减，还不断的指指点点。

街道上其他人也望向这边，根本不可能有一人过来帮助陆凡。

原因很简单，一边是莫家的大少爷，一边是陆家有名的废物陆凡。见到莫云飞那陆凡开玩笑，还有不少人一同笑出声来。

“你看那陆凡，他像不像一条狗。”

“废物就只有被人欺负的份，儿子，看到了吗？你以后一定要知道要强，可不能跟那陆凡一样。”

“真丢人啊，陆家怎么不把他关起来。还让他到处乱走，真要把陆家的脸面丢完吗？”

陆凡将所有的烈焰草捡起，抬头看着莫云飞道：“我可以走了吗？”

莫云飞显然已经玩够了，拿陆凡开开玩笑没有问题，但真的要把陆凡怎么样，莫云飞还没有想过。

毕竟，陆凡也是陆家的人，虽然地位不高，但打了陆家的脸，陆家也会找他麻烦的。

莫云飞今天只想开心，不想惹麻烦。

“我对欺负废物，没有兴趣。你走吧。”

陆凡在莫云飞的笑声中离去，眼中冷光一片。

这个世道就是这样，强者可以随意欺凌弱者。他已经做了十多年的弱者，真的不想再做了。

陆凡暗暗咬牙，现在他有了可以变成强者的迹象，就算拼了命，他也要变成强者。

莫云飞可能不知道，他今天的举动，彻底点燃了陆凡胸膛之中熊熊的火焰。

而这一团火焰，最终将变成一片火海，燃烧整个世界。

content_en:
The next morning, the sky was blue and cloudless, and the sun was shining with golden light.

The streets were covered with snow, and people were passing by in a hurry.Lu Fan strode towards the medicine shop with his pockets full of gold coins, which was almost all his savings.

After receiving the martial arts Bengshan Fist last night, Lu Fan studied it carefully, first understood it, read it thoroughly, and then started practicing.

He discovered that the most critical issue in practicing Bengshan Quan was not the arm problem, but the medicinal materials.

This set of martial arts is practiced together with medicinal materials, and requires a better healing medicinal material, flame grass.And if there is no such medicinal ingredient, then simply smashing your arm against a stone is undoubtedly an idiotic act.

Therefore, Lu Fan went out to buy this medicinal material early in the morning.

Lu Fan still knew something about the flame grass.After all, he is also from a martial arts family, and he must know the uses of various medicinal materials. After all, the Lu family also owns a medicinal materials shop, but the ones sold are very expensive, and even if his own disciples buy them, they will not get discounts.

When we walked to the main city street, this street was bustling with people.

The cold weather cannot reduce everyone's enthusiasm for shopping.The vendors and shops lined up along the street are still full of customers.

As Lu Fan walked, he looked for the figure of Flame Grass.If you can find it at a hawker stall outside, it will undoubtedly be the best.Because the prices offered by hawkers are usually much cheaper than those in stores, and they can be negotiated depending on the situation, which is very suitable for people like Lu Fan who don't have deep pockets.

After looking for half the street, Lu Fan didn't see the flame grass.

Flame grass is a fiery red medicinal material. White roots are the best, blue is the second best, and whole body red is the best.

Lu Fan searched stalls one by one. Finally, he saw a pile of fiery red flame grass in front of a hawker stall near the weapons shop.

Lu Fan was overjoyed and walked forward slowly, as if strolling around, rummaging around in front of the vendor, looking around, then picked up one of the flame grasses and said, "How much does this cost?"

Lu Fan frowned slightly. Five silver coins were already equivalent to a month's expenses for an ordinary family of three.He only had more than ten gold coins in total, and it was obvious that he couldn't buy all the pile of flame grass in front of him.

Lu Fan put down the flame grass and said, "It's too expensive. I'd better look elsewhere."

As he turned to leave, the hawker stopped him and said, "Then it's four silver coins per plant. If you buy more, I'll give you a discount. Master, this kind of flame grass is not easy to pick. If you go to buy it elsewhere, the price will definitely not be as good."

Lu Fan turned his head and rummaged through the pile of flame grass, secretly counting in his mind how many flame grass there were in the pile and whether it would be enough to last him for a month.

While counting, Lu Fan suddenly reached out and touched the roots of the flame grass, and suddenly found that the roots of several flame grasses were actually white.

His heart beat suddenly. The white-rooted flame grass was more than ten times more valuable than the completely red flame grass.According to the Bengshanquan martial arts book, if you use white flame grass to practice, your speed will be doubled.

Lu Fan forced himself to hold back his ecstasy and prevent any change in his expression.

After adjusting his mood, Lu Fan held out three fingers to the vendor and said, "Three silver coins for each plant. I want all of yours."

The vendor gritted his teeth, thought for a while and said, "Deal."

Lu Fan immediately paid him and then reached out to pick up a pile of flame grass.

While he was secretly feeling happy, his body was suddenly hit by someone.Turning around, he saw a young man in warrior uniform.

This man looks to be about the same age as Lu Fan, with a Chinese character face, a tall build, and a blue warrior uniform with the unique logo of the martial arts academy.It was obvious that this man was proud to be a student of the martial arts academy.

Lu Fan also recognized him. He was Mo Yunfei, the young master of the Mo family, the number one martial arts family in Jiang Lincheng.

"Hey, isn't this Lu Fan, the loser of the Lu family? Why, you got up early in the morning to help the family buy medicinal materials. Shouldn't you go to Xishan to collect medicinal materials?"

Mo Yunfei smiled happily, and the Mo family servants following him also laughed at the same time.

Reaching out, Mo Yunfei took two flame grasses from Lu Fan's arms.Lu Fan snatched it back and said, "Master Mo, you go shopping on your street and we won't disturb each other. Let's say goodbye."

Several servants behind Mo Yunfei blocked Lu Fan's way.Mo Yunfei looked Lu Fan up and down and said, "We haven't seen each other for a few days. Have you become hardened? Even if Lu Ming is in front of me, he wouldn't dare to be arrogant. Who do you think you are?"

Lu Fan said: "Master Mo, you should say this to Lu Ming."

Mo Yunfei smiled, clapped his hands and said, "That's good. I will find an opportunity to teach him a lesson. Look at your Lu family, you still support a waste like you, and you still want to compare with our Mo family. You are really not even a little bit worse."

With that said, Mo Yunfei stretched out his hand and scattered the medicinal materials in Lu Fan's hand to the ground.

Lu Fan's eyes were filled with anger and he had already clenched his fists.His brain told him to calm down. Mo Yunfei was at least the strongest warrior in body training, and he could never be his opponent.

Forcibly controlling his emotions, Lu Fan bent down and picked up the flame grass from the ground bit by bit.

Mo Yunfei stood aside and watched, his laughter continued and he kept pointing.

Other people on the street were also looking here, and it was impossible for anyone to come to help Lu Fan.

The reason is very simple. On one side is the eldest young master of the Mo family, and on the other side is the famous good-for-nothing Lu Fan of the Lu family.Seeing Mo Yunfei and Lu Fan joking, many people laughed out loud.

"Look at Lu Fan, does he look like a dog?"

"The only thing good for a loser is to be bullied. Son, do you see? You must know how to be strong in the future, and you can't be like that Lu Fan."

"It's so shameful. Why didn't the Lu family lock him up? You let him roam around. Do you really want to embarrass the Lu family?"

Lu Fan picked up all the flame grass, looked up at Mo Yunfei and said, "Can I go?"

Mo Yunfei has obviously had enough fun. It's okay to make fun of Lu Fan, but Mo Yunfei hasn't thought about what he really wants to do to Lu Fan.

After all, Lu Fan is also a member of the Lu family. Although his status is not high, if he slaps the Lu family in the face, the Lu family will also cause trouble for him.

Mo Yunfei just wanted to be happy today and didn't want to get into trouble.

"I have no interest in bullying losers. Just leave."

Lu Fan left amid Mo Yunfei's laughter, with a cold light in his eyes.

This is how the world is, the strong can bully the weak at will.He has been a weakling for over ten years and really doesn't want to do it anymore.

Lu Fan secretly gritted his teeth. Now that he had signs of becoming a strong man, he would become a strong man even if he risked his life.

Mo Yunfei may not know that his actions today completely ignited the raging fire in Lu Fan's chest.

And this flame will eventually turn into a sea of ​​fire and burn the entire world.
